avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer reduces isavuconazole levels by approximately 50-60%, significantly decreasing antifungal efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Absolutely contraindicated; select alternative supplement or antifungal

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin/Rifampicin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer substantially reduces isavuconazole plasma concentrations below therapeutic levels
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative antimicrobial if possible

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Calcium supplements (>1200mg daily)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May reduce isavuconazole absorption when taken simultaneously; calcium chelation effect
avoid_supplements.action: Separate dosing by at least 2 hours; take isavuconazole first

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential mild CYP3A4 inhibition may slightly increase isavuconazole levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased adverse effects; generally acceptable but document use

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases isavuconazole bioavailability and plasma concentrations, elevating toxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Avoid consumption during entire course of therapy

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase isavuconazole absorption; take consistently either with or without food for predictable levels
caution_foods.action: Maintain consistent dietary pattern; document meal timing with doses

monitoring_notes: Monitor for signs of treatment failure or breakthrough infections if CYP3A4 inducers are coadministered. Assess for adverse effects (QT prolongation, hepatotoxicity) particularly if CYP3A4 inhibitors increase drug levels or in patients with renal impairment (eGFR <30 mL/min).
